title: How Healthcare Organizations Use Claude Tag
summary: Claude Tag, a beta feature in Slack, brings Claude into channels as a teammate via @Claude mentions. It reads threads, accesses connected tools, and retains channel memory, enabling healthcare organizations to automate processes like alert handling while maintaining granular access controls for PHI compliance.

title: Building an AI-native revenue organization
summary: Anthropic released an eBook for revenue leaders implementing Claude in sales organizations, covering maturity models, rollout strategies, ROI measurement, and a 3-phase implementation plan mapped by sales role. Cox Communications is cited achieving 7x ROI in the first year of AI investment.

title: Agentic coding is straining CI. Here's how we scaled test impact analysis at Anthropic
summary: Anthropic scaled test impact analysis infrastructure as CI job volume grew 25x with Claude authoring 80% of code. The redesign replaced temporary fixes with an in-memory data store and stateless, horizontally-scalable workers. Teams should anticipate 25x load increases within two quarters under agentic coding workflows.

title: Deploying AI from Pilot to Production
summary: Anthropic released an eBook co-authored with Accenture on transitioning enterprise AI pilots into production. It introduces a four-tier oversight model and cost-of-ownership framework, providing a transition blueprint with decision points and seven chronological considerations for sustaining enterprise-wide AI impact.

title: Claude for Financial Advisors
summary: Anthropic released a suite of connectors and workflow skills for financial advisors, integrating with 11+ major platforms including Charles Schwab, Vanguard, and BlackRock. The skills automate pre-meeting preparation, compliance reviews, estate/tax analysis, and portfolio rebalancing, freeing advisors to spend more time with clients; Claude drafts and briefs for advisor review, maintaining human oversight.

title: What 1,000 small business owners taught us about AI
summary: Anthropic completed its Claude SMB Tour across 10 U.S. cities, engaging over 1,000 small business owners in free workshops integrating AI with tools like QuickBooks and PayPal. Key findings: non-technical owners can build custom workflows when guided, accuracy validation and data security are top concerns, and hands-on building sessions drive adoption faster than passive instruction. Anthropic is launching a Claude SMB Trainer Program and expanding to Boston on September 16.
